title: Implement deterministic Risk Classifier and Verification Policy
description: Implement frozen multi-agent Item 4: deterministic risk floor from Project Map sensitive zones, manager escalation with max-rule semantics, and fail-closed verification requirements by effective risk.

why_medium: This policy becomes a repository-governance control that determines future task risk and required verification gates.
A defect could under-classify or over-classify later tasks even though this task does not mutate protected commerce, auth, migration, financial, or production business state.
The implementation is deterministic, additive, isolated to the multi-agent governance surface, and normally reversible.
why_not_high: No payment, pricing, inventory, authentication, authorization, finance, irreversible database migration, destructive production operation, security policy, GitHub ruleset, or protected-main setting is changed.
The changed files are outside all current Project Map HIGH sensitive zones.
No Human Gate or merge-policy enforcement is implemented or weakened by this task.

lock.rule: No conflicting writer may mutate these paths until this Item 4 PR is merged or aborted.

policy_decisions.manager_downgrade_evidence: Return immutable MANAGER_DOWNGRADE_REJECTED governance event without nondeterministic timestamp data.
policy_decisions.not_executed_rule: NOT_EXECUTED never satisfies a required verification gate.

acceptance_criteria.description: Risk values are restricted to LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH and malformed risk input fails closed.
Deterministic risk floor is derived only from changed paths and Project Map sensitive-zone minimum risks; no LLM may lower the floor.
Effective risk is max(deterministic floor, manager risk), so Manager may escalate but never downgrade below the deterministic floor.
Sensitive-zone matches are deterministic, path-normalized, sorted, evidence-bearing and fail closed on malformed zone definitions.
Verification policy requires executed verification for LOW, review plus verification for MEDIUM, and review plus verification plus security for HIGH; HIGH separately requires Human Gate.
NOT_EXECUTED is never equivalent to PASS and any required gate not exactly PASS keeps verification blocked.
Policy/classification outputs are defensively frozen so downstream callers cannot mutate decision evidence in place.
Existing multi-agent wildcard test integration includes Item 4 without package.json changes and full canonical verification remains green.
PR diff contains only the three declared write-scope files and no forbidden path.

Conditional Review Q-1/Q-2/Q-3 are explicit regressions: payment paths force HIGH floor, multiple zones choose the maximum floor, and Manager downgrade attempts are rejected while producing immutable deterministic governance evidence.
